_comment.country: provider.availableAt[*].address.addressCountry == 'FR' — restricts results to hotels located in France (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code).
_comment.city: provider.availableAt[*].address.addressLocality == 'Paris' — narrows the country match down to hotels in the city of Paris specifically.
_comment.adultCapacity: resources[*].resourceAttributes.maxOccupancy.adults >= 2 — only returns room resources that can accommodate at least 2 adults.
_comment.childrenCapacity: resources[*].resourceAttributes.maxOccupancy.children >= 2 — only returns room resources that can accommodate at least 2 children, for families traveling with kids.
_comment.starRating: resources[*].resourceAttributes.starRating >= 4 — limits results to 4-star and 5-star rated properties.
_comment.childAgeLimit: resources[*].resourceAttributes.childAgeLimit >= 10 — only returns rooms whose child-occupancy policy still counts a 10-year-old as a child (rather than requiring an adult rate). This field is hypothetical and does not exist in the HotelResource v0.1 schema yet; it would need to be added to schema/HotelResource/v0.1/attributes.yaml and populated in catalog_publish.json before this clause could actually be evaluated by a Discovery Service.
_comment.checkinDate: resources[*].resourceAttributes.checkinDate <= '2026-09-10' — hypothetical field, not yet in HotelResource v0.1. Represents the earliest date this room resource is available from; combined with checkoutDate below to check that the resource's availability window covers the guest's requested stay. In the real OTRAMS/dynamic flow this is a live-search parameter (checkin_date), not a static catalog attribute — added here into resourceAttributes only because that was explicitly requested.
_comment.checkoutDate: resources[*].resourceAttributes.checkoutDate >= '2026-09-12' — hypothetical field, not yet in HotelResource v0.1. Represents the latest date this room resource remains available until. Same caveat as checkinDate: normally a live-search parameter, not a static catalog field.
_comment.nationality: resources[*].resourceAttributes.nationality == 'IN' — hypothetical field, not yet in HotelResource v0.1. Represents the guest nationality this room rate is eligible for, mirroring OTRAMS' sel_nationality rate-eligibility input. Distinct from the country filter above: country matches the hotel's location, nationality matches the guest's nationality. Also normally a live rate-eligibility parameter rather than a static catalog attribute.
